title: Missing Number (Sum Formula)
summary: An array holds n different numbers taken from 0 to n, so one is missing: subtract the array's sum from the sum 0 + 1 + ... + n.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Array values
inputs.note: n different whole numbers from 0 to n (n is the array length, at most 15).

anchors.label: The sum the array should have, and a running sum
